scope: Buildings and indexed-scans residual abstraction review; no production edits
overall: No patch-introduced defect established. Two pre-existing transport-semantic defects reproduced on current source. Remaining ownership concerns are risks, not confirmed failures.
runtime_proof: flab-abstraction-review-probe.log; process exit 0; logical transport graph fixtures only, not full physical paste validation

priorities.status: confirmed current bug; pre-existing according to source comparison
priorities.title: Piler-blind endpoint discovery loses hierarchical output supply
priorities.observed: Producer->sorter->belt2->Piler3->belt4: output_belt_tails=[]; input_belt_heads=[2,4]; hierarchy outputs=[], inputs=[4]. The actual transport output at belt4 is absent from cut supply and misidentified as input.
priorities.abstraction: Canonical transport adjacency over Buildings plus an explicit boundary endpoint policy. Serial Piler transit must not terminate a producer trunk or manufacture an exposed input. Preserve intentional splitter-branch boundary policy rather than simply traversing every host everywhere.
migration: other output endpoint walks after references review
priorities.regression_contract: A piled producer output remains a rated hierarchy output; piler out-port belts are not exposed inputs. Include multiple serial pilers, ordinary belt chain, real external input, and splitter-branch policies.

priorities.status: confirmed current bug; pre-existing according to source comparison
priorities.title: Router and validator disagree on flow through a Piler
priorities.observed: Belt0->Piler1->belt2->belt0: _leads_back(0,{2})=false and _committed_path_closes_cycle([0])=false; real belt.acyclic validator reports cycle [0,1,2].
priorities.abstraction: One directed transport-successor query over the live Buildings owner, accounting for belt forward edges and reverse-input output belts of Splitters/Pilers. Reuse that adjacency in distinct reachability/Tarjan/validation algorithms; do not merge their algorithms or item-specific policies.
priorities.regression_contract: Admission guard sees every transport cycle the validator sees, including Piler transit, while legal merges/shared prefixes remain acyclic.

priorities.title: Paths and StakedPaths retain separate mutable authority
priorities.risk: Mutation paths must update both holders; rollback fingerprint uses dict equality while stake/scan order is observable. Equal mappings do not prove equal subsequent route tie behavior.
priorities.abstraction: Promote existing StakedPaths to the ordered mapping/snapshot/restore owner instead of adding another graph wrapper. Migrate _stake/_unstake, endpoint readers and last-mile transactions together.
priorities.required_probe: Fail a cluster transaction after unrelated stakes; compare ordered paths and indexed endpoint/linked-head/position answers before and after exact rollback. Prove a reachable mismatch before calling it a bug.

priorities.title: Corridor ownership spans three mutation stores
priorities.risk: canvas.reserved, canvas.port_corridors and grid.reserved must retire and restore together; PortReservations correctly owns its reverse index but not the entire corridor transaction.
priorities.abstraction: A call-local corridor reservation transaction owner with snapshot/retire/restore around existing stores, preserving demand-kind eligibility and first forward insertion precedence.
priorities.required_probe: Cancel after one held corridor, then fail last-mile rerouting with two corridors for one port; compare membership and first_for ordering. Do not extract merely to shorten repeated loops.

lower_priority_contracts: Nets snapshots keys while retaining mutable payloads; current code does not mutate those key fields after indexing. Establish an immutable row contract before changing behavior.
ReferenceGraph snapshots edges while retaining live graph mappings; current use is call-local. A frozen graph snapshot is a possible tighter contract, not evidence of a current failure.

Buildings.belt_run documents Splitter/Piler starting anchors but currently ignores a non-belt seed. The only production caller supplies belts. Narrow the documented contract or deliberately support junction starts; nonblocking.
preserve_distinctions: Declared footprint index versus physical collision versus routing keepout; sorter/addon exclusions and fractional ramp altitude are deliberately different.
Unique all-building predecessor, last all-building writer, unique belt predecessor and last belt writer are different policies. Share storage, not accidental precedence.
Cycle-refusing stable topology order versus BlockGraph's deliberate cycle-breaking order.
Root-sensitive UnionFind policy; item/cargo-specific graph traversal; internal versus external endpoint allocation.
inspected_without_confirmed_defect: MutableBuildings copying, indexed rewrite restrictions, relink buckets, live z reads and snapshot/clone lifetime
Stages append/replace count, frozen observations, solve-local identity positions, read-only flow maps and trace sequence ordering
